scope: Source and mocked acceptance for the location-bound scheduled sensor pull contract. No candidate or legacy database, external provider, configured driver instance, Prefect deployment, or persisted schedule was accessed or changed.

registry_constraints: registered driver is enabled and sensor typed
instance location exactly matches task location
loaded driver identity matches registry name
driver explicitly opts into scheduled pull
implementation.transaction: Accepted sensor reading, ingestion audit, platform event and ClickHouse outbox projection writes share one PostgreSQL transaction. Exact timestamp/value retries are suppressed without republishing the event; conflicting values fail and roll back the batch.

focused_tests.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_sensor_driver_schedule.py tests/test_scheduled_command_contracts.py tests/test_core_jobs_contract.py tests/test_sensor_ingester_cli_contract.py tests/test_prefect_workflow.py tests/test_worker_job_contract_inventory.py

inventory_tests.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_worker_operation_map.py tests/test_worker_job_contract_inventory.py tests/test_runtime_sql_inventory.py tests/test_worker_sql_inventory.py tests/test_worker_source_closure.py tests/test_worker_function_reachability.py tests/test_worker_sql_reachability.py tests/test_worker_boundary_preflight.py

quality_checks.capability_matrix: valid: 66 rows; 55 baseline-retained, 7 deployed, 4 prepared; zero MAN-CAP acceptances

remaining_gates: real driver source and owner configuration
provider output parity and replay-watermark acceptance
active schedule and external dispatcher reconciliation
signed worker identity and tenant authorization
